title: Test cross-cohort expression transfer, inherited susceptibility and long-lag population associations
question: Which endometriosis associations remain interpretable across independently recruited cohorts, measurement methods and registry definitions?
scope: Exploratory real-data comparisons of a complete transcriptomic profile, expression predicted by inherited susceptibility variants, and published long-lag ovarian cancer histotype counts. Each comparison retains its own estimand.
steps: Audit molecular measurements, processing order, registry denominators, phenotype definitions and pre-existing evidence.
Evaluate full expression weights and a direction-fixed uterine genetics score in separately recruited endometrial cohorts.
Calculate population contrasts from public aggregates and retain source-specific interpretations.
deliverables: Reproducible offline methods, aggregate data and source-linked research notes.
Documented controls, missing coverage, cohort overlap risks and null findings.
acceptance: Recompute the main estimates with independent checks or reference calculations.
Keep all individual records outside the repository.
Expose assumptions that can change the interpretation and distinguish prior art from new calculations.
